headline: Two Omega De Ville: $5,100 or $5,500?
stop_reason: Project folder exists and passes validate, but the rendered slides fail the house rules: slide 2 shows grey panels behind the option photos, and slide 3 shows a cream band behind the Omega cut-out. The Omega pair (43413402003001 $5,100 and 43410402010001 $5,500, both 21 Nov 2026) is the only same-date pair within 10% that avoids the 14:30 Cartier post, and its photos are the problem. Needs either a template fix for cut-outs on black or a different pair from library dates 20-21 Nov (e.g. Grand Seiko SBGW279 $4,600 with a compliant photo).
